sections.heading: Charity at Clark: SMOKE10 Cause-Driven Race

paragraphs: Clark Parade Grounds in the Clark Freeport Zone is one of the Philippines premier running venues. The wide boulevards, minimal traffic, and purpose-built road infrastructure create a running environment that is unmatched in the Philippine road-race landscape. Clark flat terrain and generous road width make it one of the most PB-friendly venues in the country [1][2].
sections.heading: Clark Parade Grounds: The Runner Freeport

paragraphs: The course starts and finishes at Clark Parade Grounds, extending onto Clark wide, well-maintained roads. Four distances (21K, 10K, 5K, 3K) cover the full running spectrum from serious half-marathoners to families and first-timers. Clark road network is designed for large-scale events, and traffic management is well-practised from the numerous races held at the venue [1].
sections.heading: The Course: Clark Roads and the Parade Grounds

paragraphs: August is the peak of the Philippine southwest monsoon, with Pampanga experiencing warm, humid conditions and a significant chance of rain. Morning temperatures range from 26-29C with humidity above 80 percent. Clark open roads provide good drainage and the early-morning start reduces solar exposure. Pack lightweight, quick-drying kit and prepare for the possibility of rain [3].
